These fixtures are bounded excerpts of official public responses captured 1 November 2026 for parser and admission tests. Actual original response URLs, SHA256 hashes and retrieval receipts are in output/stitch-page-audit-2026-11-01/market/market-capture-report.json. Candidate fixtures deliberately retain selected observations from those complete captures; receipt hashes identify the original fetched response, not these test excerpts. The small H10 ZIP contains the original selected yen series metadata and last five observations re-packed by the existing test ZIP writer. The DKW CSV keeps the original preamble/header plus selected early, negative-premium, scientific-notation and latest rows. The tri-party workbook and SEP accessible HTML are bounded original public files. No fixture is a simulated market observation.
Additional specialist regression captures:
- fomc-calendar.json is the complete retained official FOMC calendar family captured 1 November 2026, including listed 2026/2027 decisions and its original receipt.
- refunding-candidate.json is the complete admitted Treasury refunding candidate from the same audit, including role-resolved original document receipts and native documents.
- yields-curve-excerpt.json retains the final three actual Treasury curve rows plus the original family metadata and receipt list. It is a test excerpt, not a replacement canonical capture.
- dealer-window-candidate.json retains the final 52 actual weekly observations for each dealer series with native signed components and original response receipts, for descriptive complete-window rank checks.
- bls-request-receipts.json retains the four actual November BLS desk request receipts, two adjacent original historical BLS request receipts and the captured January 1933 CPI row with its year-ago baseline, for CSV batch and year-scope lineage checks.
